children: Hong Kong’s exports surged 53% year-on-year to $667.9 billion in August 2026, accelerating from 50.7% in the previous month.

Export growth was led by electrical machinery, apparatus and appliances, and electrical parts thereof (62.6% vs 54% in July), office machines and automatic data processing machines (131% vs 106.5%), power generating machinery and equipment (19.9% vs 16.7%), and non-ferrous metals (128.9% vs 84.3%).
In contrast, sales eased notably for telecommunications and sound recording and reproducing apparatus and equipment (20.2% vs 37.2%) and miscellaneous manufactured articles (44.1% vs 108.7%).
Regionally, exports to Asia jumped 59.2%, led by Mainland China (61.2%), Malaysia (101.7%), and Vietnam (83.3%).
Exports to other major markets also recorded strong gains, including the US (64.2%) and Mexico (68.8%).

title: Hong Kong Exports Soar 53% in August
